items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Because Buster and I were kind of pals, you know.

ctx.x: Well, that's the trouble with having a big band with a lot of stars in it. You understand? When you've got a band with a lot of stars, you try to distribute them out, you know... It makes it... You'd have to play all night long to get everybody featured. That's the trouble with being in a big band. You know? It's better to have a small band. You know? I mean that as far as the player is concerned, now. As far as the people listening, maybe they want to hear that big sound. You know? You've got to have guys that…
But look, Fletcher had Coleman Hawkins. He had Joe Smith. He had Buster Bailey. He had...
